Ava (CSM): quick heads-up — Granite's weekly active seats are ~10% of baseline this month, and token volume dropped ~85% :cold_sweat:
Diego (AM): wow. any errors or auth issues? link to dashboard? :eyes:
Ava (CSM): no errors showing. just big drop in embeddings + rerank calls. dashboard: https://console.redwood.ai/accounts/granite/usage (private)
Priya (RevOps): FYI I just spoke with their champion — they moved to an interim ML lead last week. champion said the new lead spun up an on-prem pilot with competitor X.ai to test inference latency/cost.
Diego (AM): ok that's the competitive signal. do we know pilot scale?
Priya (RevOps): small — ~5k queries/day for now. they focused on batch rerank throughput and a 99th-pct latency target. champion worried about token costs, asked for cost-per-1M-token numbers.
Ava (CSM): Renewal is in 2 months. I'm worried this drift + exec swap could cascade. recommend short triage call with new ML lead and champion ASAP.
Nikhil (SE): I can pull a quick latency/cost comparison and a short one-pager. can someone paste their typical batch size / sequence length?
Ava (CSM): champion mentioned avg seq len ~600, batch size 64 for rerank.
Diego (AM): I'll own outreach. scheduling window tomorrow 9-11 PT.
Priya (RevOps): tagging renewal_watch. also BillingBot: will reduced usage trigger any billing/contract thresholds to flag? :thinking_face:
BillingBot: Automated notice — projected invoice variance for Q3: -72% vs forecast. Suggesting proactive alert to finance and CSM.
Nikhil (SE): draft plan: 1) quick benchmark doc (latency + cost for seq 600, batch 64), 2) sample prompt set to validate quality parity, 3) offer a 2-week dedicated capacity window to reproduce their pilot at no extra charge.
Ava (CSM): love that. Diego, can you surface any contract clauses that permit a short dedicated trial?
Diego (AM): will check — likely okay under trial allowance. looping legal if needed.
Priya (RevOps): I'll prep the cost delta table for them and add a line showing caching/batching savings we can configure.
Nikhil (SE): will have the one-pager + microbench numbers in ~3 hours.
Ava (CSM): action items summarized: Diego = schedule call + contract check; Nikhil = one-pager + bench; Priya = cost delta + configure suggestions; I'll prep a convo plan and outreach note.
Diego (AM): scheduled 9:30am PT tomorrow. invite sent to champion + new ML lead.
Ava (CSM): thanks. if pilot shows performance parity but cost advantage, we push hard on retention play. if not, offer migration support. :thumbsup:
Priya (RevOps): adding internal note to account: "At-risk: usage drop + new ML lead evaluating competitor pilot — triage call scheduled".
BillingBot: Flag created: account-impact Q3, notify finance and renewals.
Ava (CSM): tagging @renewal-watch (internal channel) and closing loop here — please post artifacts in the account folder after they're ready. :white_check_mark:
